mentions.note: a boy of slender build; fine style; 10. in the Horwood Cup (64 16); 7 in handicap
8th, 62 2; 16 seconds behind Harry Churcher in the club Open 7 miles
two miles walk first class standard medal
died aged under 21; walker known as "Jim"; won Belgrave Open Seven Miles handicap and London Fire Brigade S.C. 2 miles; 5th in Polytechnic Harriers Invitation Team Walk, White City

share.d: H. S. Latter in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1931–1934: 9 mentions in 7 issues and 5 race results.
